execution_contract.exact_version_preflight: Record cargo/rustc 1.95.0 and cargo nextest 0.9.137; verify which cargo-nextest resolves to the bound private binary.
execution_contract.identity: Recheck every bound input and configuration presence immediately before and after; require unchanged source, retained qualified binaries and nextest executable.
execution_contract.ownership: Record original Popen PID/birth/group, supervise and wait/reap only that owned process group; unknown cleanup or timed-out dispatch must be reconciled before any resubmission.
execution_contract.pass_requires: Both exact commands exit0, no timeout or automatic retry, complete case/count match to actual qualified inventory, unchanged inputs, and original owned child/group absent.
execution_contract.scheduling: Run only after the bound original qualification01 terminal success, with no overlapping compiler or measurement campaign.

expected_nextest.comparison: Require full exact unfiltered case inventory and ignored set, plus footer counts; zero-test targets may be omitted from a runner's display, but no nonempty target or case may disappear.

inventory_command.scope: One unfiltered structured inventory; Cargo may build and test binaries execute --list, but no test case is executed by this command.

limits: External command evidence does not mark hosted GitHub Actions passed.
Offline Cargo, private completed qualification01 target/cache and prebuilt pinned nextest are explicit environment differences from GitHub's online clean runner and cargo-install step.
Publishing the tested source and prospective-merge Git tree binding remain separate.
No measurement, deployment or candidate adoption is implied by materializing this plan.
reporting_environment_note: Pinned nextest0.9.137 supported reporting-only environment settings preserve original run argv, emit every completed success once, suppress successful test stdout and keep color-free evidence. They do not alter case selection, retries or execution concurrency.

workflow_binding.scope: exact commands from the published workflow; private qualified source workflow remains unchanged
